items.prompt: The waiting area of a private clinic: white walls, a water cooler with paper cups, a leatherette sofa. The woman, about forty, shoulder-length dark hair, a light raincoat, sits alone on the sofa, seen from behind at a distance, her head bent over a phone. Beside her stands a small wheeled suitcase with one crooked wheel. Polished floor tiles, quiet, much empty space.

alt.ru: Зал ожидания клиники: женщина в светлом плаще спиной к нам сидит на диване с телефоном, рядом чемодан на колёсиках, у стены кулер.
alt.en: A clinic waiting area: a woman in a light raincoat sits with her back to us on a sofa, looking at a phone, a wheeled suitcase beside her, a water cooler by the wall.
alt.pt: Sala de espera de uma clínica: uma mulher de capa clara, de costas, num sofá com o celular, ao lado uma mala de rodinhas, um bebedouro junto à parede.
alt.es: Sala de espera de una clínica: una mujer con gabardina clara, de espaldas, en un sofá con el teléfono, al lado una maleta con ruedas, un dispensador de agua junto a la pared.

caption.ru: Она приехала прямо из аэропорта. Одно колесо у чемодана заедало и пищало.
caption.en: She came straight from the airport. One wheel of the suitcase stuck and squeaked.
caption.pt: Ela veio direto do aeroporto. Uma roda da mala emperrava e guinchava.
caption.es: Vino directa del aeropuerto. Una rueda de la maleta se atascaba y chirriaba.

items.prompt: An MRI room in a private clinic. A man lies on the sliding table, already inside the round bore of the scanner up to his chest; we see only his legs under a checked blanket and one hand at his side loosely holding a small rubber squeeze bulb on a cable. The dark ring of the machine fills the frame. Cold, even light.

alt.ru: Аппарат МРТ: мужчина задвинут в трубу, видны ноги под клетчатым пледом и рука с резиновой грушей.
alt.en: An MRI scanner: a man slid into the tube, only his legs under a checked blanket and a hand with a rubber bulb visible.
alt.pt: Um aparelho de ressonância: um homem dentro do tubo, veem-se só as pernas sob uma manta xadrez e a mão com uma pera de borracha.
alt.es: Un aparato de resonancia: un hombre dentro del tubo, solo se ven las piernas bajo una manta de cuadros y la mano con una pera de goma.

caption.ru: Сорок минут грохота. Грушу он так и не нажал.
caption.en: Forty minutes of racket. He never squeezed the bulb.
caption.pt: Quarenta minutos de estrondo. Ele não apertou a pera.
caption.es: Cuarenta minutos de estruendo. No llegó a apretar la pera.
